semantic_fragments.content: Shock test (IEC 60068-2-27:2008) for non-hand-held ME equipment, parts, and mounting accessories - Test Type 1: Peak acceleration 150 m/s² (15 g), Duration 11 ms, half-sine pulse, 3 shocks per direction per axis (18 total). Represents Class 7M2 per IEC/TR 60721-4-7:2001. Verdict: N/A.

Shock test (IEC 60068-2-27:2008) for non-hand-held ME equipment, parts, and mounting accessories - Test Type 2: Peak acceleration 300 m/s² (15 g), Duration 6 ms, half-sine pulse, 3 shocks per direction per axis (18 total). Verdict: N/A.

Shock test (IEC 60068-2-27:2008) for hand-held ME equipment, parts, and mounting accessories - Test Type 1: Peak acceleration 300 m/s² (30 g), Duration 11 ms, half-sine pulse, 3 shocks per direction per axis (18 total). Represents Class 7M3 per IEC/TR 60721-4-7:2001. Verdict: N/A.

Broad-band random vibration test (IEC 60068-2-64:2008) for ME equipment, parts, and mounting accessories: Acceleration amplitudes defined as 10-100 Hz: 1.0 (m/s²)²/Hz; 100-200 Hz: -3 dB/octave; 200-2000 Hz: 0.5 (m/s²)²/Hz. Duration: 30 min per perpendicular axis (3 axes total). Test performed across 3 perpendicular axes and 3 acceleration amplitude sets. Verdict: N/A.
